questions.q: What planet is closest to the sun?
questions.explanation: Mercury is the closest planet to the sun.

questions.q: What gas do plants absorb from the air?
questions.explanation: Plants absorb carbon dioxide for photosynthesis.

questions.q: How many bones are in the human body?
questions.explanation: An adult human skeleton has 206 bones.

questions.q: What is the boiling point of water at sea level?
questions.explanation: Water boils at 100°C (212°F) at sea level.

questions.q: Which organ pumps blood through the body?
questions.explanation: The heart pumps blood through the circulatory system.

questions.q: What is the chemical symbol for gold?
questions.explanation: Au comes from the Latin word 'aurum'.

questions.q: What force keeps planets in orbit around the sun?
questions.explanation: Gravity pulls planets toward the sun, keeping them in orbit.

questions.q: What part of the cell contains genetic material?
questions.explanation: The nucleus houses the cell's DNA.

questions.q: Which layer of Earth is mostly liquid metal?
questions.explanation: The outer core is liquid iron and nickel.

questions.q: What type of energy is stored in food?
questions.explanation: Food stores chemical energy that cells convert to usable energy.

questions.q: What is the powerhouse of the cell?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria produce most of the cell's ATP energy.

questions.q: Which law states that force equals mass times acceleration?
questions.explanation: F = ma is Newton's Second Law of Motion.

questions.q: What particle has a negative electric charge?
questions.explanation: Electrons carry a negative charge and orbit the nucleus.

questions.q: What process do plants use to convert light into energy?
questions.explanation: Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy.
